name: Kettlebell Windmill
steps: Press one kettlebell straight overhead, set your feet wider than shoulder-width, and angle both toes roughly 45 degrees away from the overhead arm.
Lock your overhead arm straight, keep your eyes on the bell, and push your hip out toward the loaded side.
Hinge sideways and backward at the hips while tracing your free hand slowly down the inside of your front leg toward the floor.
Squeeze your glutes and obliques to stand smoothly back upright while keeping the bell stacked overhead, and switch sides after finishing one arm.
tips: Keep the majority of your weight on the back leg under the kettlebell with your front knee softly unlocked.
Hinge only as low as you can while keeping a flat back and a vertical overhead arm.
